A close reading for the week

“always the woman”

A Scandal in Bohemia · the opening

Watson begins the first collected Holmes story by naming the person who escaped his friend’s usual categories. Before the mystery starts, the result is already in view.

To Sherlock Holmes1 she is always the woman.2 I have seldom heard him mention her under any other name. In his eyes she eclipses and predominates the whole of her sex.

  1. 1

    “To Sherlock Holmes”

    The opening limits its claim: this is what Adler is “to” Holmes. It tells us the place she holds in his memory, and leaves the rest of who she is unsaid.

  2. 2

    Singular and reduced

    The title makes Adler incomparable, but also emblematic. Watson praises her by separating her from “the whole of her sex”, a pattern the story uses and also exposes.
